entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED
entities.description: Substate entered when UE is attached for EPS and non-EPS services and wants to detach for non-EPS services only. User data and signalling information may still be sent and received.

entities.name: Combined detach procedure for non-EPS services only
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE for IMSI detach (non-EPS services only) while remaining attached for EPS services.

entities.name: UE attached for EPS and non-EPS services
entities.description: Condition where UE is attached for both EPS and non-EPS services before initiating IMSI detach.

entities.name: UE wants to detach for non-EPS services only
entities.description: Condition where UE wants to detach only for non-EPS services while maintaining EPS attachment.

relations.description: State entry is guarded by condition that UE is attached for both EPS and non-EPS services.
State entry is guarded by condition that UE wants to detach only for non-EPS services.
UE performs combined detach procedure for non-EPS services only while in this state.
